workItems.owns: weekly standing line, cohort rows, rank movement, pinned self row
global standing line, top learners, follow control, pinned self row

evidence.claim: Standing line reads 'Hang #1 · top 100%'; subtitle carries '0 XP · Reset sau 2 ngay 18 gio' as one line; row trailing is a caret.
Page has segmented Tuan nay/Toan cau tabs, standing hero with goal meter and climb CTA, a 2-1-3 podium, then rank 4+ rows.
Percentile is FE-computed as Math.max(1, Math.ceil(rank / entries.length * 100)); there is no backend percentile field.
Secondary line concatenates points and resetIn with days AND hours into one string.
Page tabs are a primary segmented TabsCard that swaps the whole board; only the active board mounts.
pointsToNext = above.points - myPoints + 1, ratio = myPoints / above.points, rendered only when the rank above is inside the fetched slice and myRank > 1.
Podium takes entries.slice(0,3) and rank 4+ becomes a followable SurfaceCardList.
Legacy unit string is '{count} XP' while the target FE ships '{count} diem'.
The target already requests tier, weekEndAt, promoteCount and demoteCount and currently renders none of them.
seeMore pushes to /league, a route that does not exist in src/app, so the production control is a dead link.
globalLeaderboard returns entries, myRank and myPoints only, with no total user count, so a global percentile is not derivable.

unknowns: Whether the percentile denominator should be the loaded cohort size or a server-side cohort capacity; the legacy formula is only correct while the full cohort is returned.
Whether the distinct generated avatars in the production render come from a legacy-only utility that the target does not yet carry.
Whether /league belongs at the bare path or under a locale segment, since the target has no locale routing today.

directions.primaryCta: The quiet 'Xem bang xep hang' link on each dashboard section; on the page, the 'Vao khoa hoc kiem XP' climb CTA.
readingOrder: standing line with rank and percentile
tradeoffs: The dashboard column stays as long as legacy, because two competition stories remain visible at once.

contracts.why: Weekly league and global standing are separate competition stories with independent request lifetimes, kept in one legacy-ordered community column.
Section label and its quiet end action stay outside the card the legacy render puts them above.
Viewer standing explains the ranked identities beneath it, so both share one competition surface while the joined list keeps its own separators.
The rank artwork fixes the viewer's current place before the standing sentence while a short deadline or tier fact remains at the far edge.
Ranked identities are comparable peers in one joined list, so rank, identity, points and row action align across the board.
Rank artwork and avatar identify the learner, identity owns spare width, points stay comparable and one movement or follow outcome remains subordinate at the row end.
A pinned self row that is far from the fetched slice must announce the gap, because placing it directly under the last row asserts an adjacency that is false.

vocabularyProposals.name: RankDeltaCaret
vocabularyProposals.meaning: Signed rank movement as a caret plus magnitude; null renders the neutral placeholder.
vocabularyProposals.why: The row trailing slot currently renders a full-sentence Badge, which the legacy render does not have and which pushes the XP column around.
vocabularyProposals.absence: delta null or zero renders the neutral placeholder and no verdict inset
vocabularyProposals.precedence: replaces the movement Badge in the ranked-user-row action slot
vocabularyProposals.compatibility: additive leaf; the Badge path stays for non-movement uses

vocabularyProposals.name: Podium
